paired_training_example.role: paired dense graph-derived coordinate reference and DAPI input
paired_training_example.derivation: Registered the five-villus DAPI rectangle embedded in the supplied Figure1 artwork to the original Day90 DAPI crop; integer bounds are in the level-0 image.

unseen_image_example.role: unseen DAPI input and frozen image-model coordinate output
unseen_image_example.derivation: Exact alternate-lower-middle Day90 region recorded by the historical Figure 1d generation code and visually matched to the right-hand DAPI/output pair in the supplied artwork.

notes: The right-hand artwork region is not the automatically selected SI2 window used by the superseded exporter.
The two examples are distinct regions from the same Day90 replicate section.
Region membership is fixed spatially and is not selected using image-model prediction error.
